title: Deep-learning models show limited external performance for preterm-birth prediction from cervical ultrasound
summary: The study reports internal evaluation and external evaluation on a separate ultrasound machine; the external AUC was 0.52. External discrimination was modest; clinical usefulness and improved pregnancy outcomes are not established. Prospective sample collection does not establish prospective evaluation of a locked model.
ai_technology: Vision Transformer models analyzed mid-trimester cervical ultrasound images to predict spontaneous preterm birth.
